title: The releases refresh asks GitHub with If-None-Match, reads each asset once, and waits for the reset when the quota is low
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/quickstart-releases-etag.test.mjs
S2: Read the ok/not ok line of each of the four tests.
expect: All four tests report ok: an unchanged list is one conditional request answered 304 with no release row rewritten; a changed list downloads no asset already read under the same id; a token under 10% of its quota makes no request until X-RateLimit-Reset; a 403 with x-ratelimit-remaining 0 is logged as the rate limit with its reset time (pre-fix: every 10-minute cycle re-downloaded ~95 assets, four stands on one token spent 5,000 requests an hour and provisioning got 403 on the quickstart download).
evidence: 19/10/2026: stands wo2 (09:52Z) and wodsft (12:30Z, 12:55Z) failed provisioning with 'quickstart download failed' (403) while four stands shared one GitHub token.

tests: an unchanged list is asked with If-None-Match
a list that changed re-reads only the assets
a token below 10% of its quota waits
